events.sharingDescription: Interactive workshop with WIT and Airwallex!

props.title: Description
props.content:
Every piece of software is rigorously tested before it reaches you 🫵.  But what exactly is software testing? 🙋‍♀️

Join WIT and Airwallex for an interactive workshop where you’ll learn from real engineers how to write unit tests, and build valuable industry skills.

Then, put your knowledge to the test in a mini competition (there's prizes up for grabs 👀)

Can you catch all the bugs?
